L01.drivers: Profile shows a deep, keel-like rounded upper trunk (chest and back both bulge) over a sharply pinched waist and narrow pelvis; narrow sloping shoulders in front; slender limbs with knobby knee bulge; trunk shape not matching human rib/back profile
axial_cues: deep rounded thoracic bulge front and back in profile
narrow pelvis relative to chest depth

structure.axial_section_shape: deep, egg-shaped thorax much deeper than wide, tapering hard into a thin waist and small pelvis
structure.joint_integration: shoulders set low and narrow; knees protrude as knobs between thin thigh and calf
structure.segment_relations: trunk relatively short and deep; legs long and thin; arms long
structure.load_path: weight from bulky thorax funnels through a thin waist and narrow pelvis into straight thin legs

non_structural_factors.notes: read is driven by trunk section shape, not bulk

L02.drivers: Average human proportions, slightly soft belly and buttock in profile, normal shoulders and hips

structure.axial_section_shape: ordinary oval chest grading into a slightly soft abdomen and normal pelvis
structure.joint_integration: smooth human shoulder, elbow, hip, knee transitions
structure.segment_relations: typical human trunk-to-leg and arm ratios
structure.load_path: vertical through pelvis and straight legs to plantigrade feet

L03.drivers: Slim average human build, normal proportions

structure.axial_section_shape: ordinary human oval trunk with mild waist
structure.segment_relations: typical human ratios, slightly long legs
structure.load_path: straight vertical through pelvis to feet

L04.drivers: Slim ordinary human body, near-identical to L03/L08

structure.load_path: straight vertical through pelvis to feet

L05.drivers: Ordinary human body with a soft, slightly protruding belly and rounded buttock in profile

structure.axial_section_shape: human oval chest over a fuller abdomen
structure.load_path: vertical through pelvis to straight legs

L06.drivers: Ordinary human, somewhat broader shoulders and fuller thighs, normal organization

structure.axial_section_shape: human trunk with mild shoulder-to-waist taper

L07.drivers: Same organization as L01: deep rounded thoracic bulge front and back in profile, pinched waist, narrow pelvis, thin limbs, knobby knees
axial_cues: deep rounded thorax front and back

structure.axial_section_shape: deep egg-shaped thorax tapering hard to thin waist and small pelvis
structure.segment_relations: short deep trunk, long thin legs and arms
structure.load_path: thorax mass funnels through thin waist to straight thin legs

L09.drivers: Slim ordinary human, slight straight-backed profile

L10.drivers: Very broad massive trunk with no real waist, thick short arms with oversized fists, short heavy bowed legs with bent knees, huge broad feet, wide stance; thick trunk merges into pelvis
limb_cues: massive ankles and broad long feet

structure.axial_section_shape: wide, deep, nearly rectangular trunk with no waist taper into a broad pelvis
structure.joint_integration: bulky shoulders merge with trunk; knees bent and knobbed; thick ankles flaring into large feet
structure.segment_relations: trunk long and dominant; legs and arms short; hands and feet oversized
structure.load_path: heavy trunk drops through wide pelvis into splayed, bent, bowed legs onto large wide feet

non_structural_factors.notes: bulk is large but the proportion and leg/foot organization drive the read

L11.drivers: Slim ordinary human, slightly broad shoulders

L12.drivers: Same body plan as L10 but even wider: huge boxy trunk, short thick arms with big fists, short bowed bent legs, very large feet, wide stance

structure.axial_section_shape: very wide, deep, boxy trunk with no waist
structure.joint_integration: massive shoulders fused into trunk; bent knobbed knees; heavy ankles
structure.segment_relations: dominant trunk, short limbs, oversized hands and feet
structure.load_path: trunk mass through wide pelvis into splayed bent legs and broad feet

groups.label: deep-keeled thorax, pinched waist, thin limbs
massive short-limbed, bent-legged, big-handed and big-footed

distinguishing_features: L01/L07 keep human-like height ratios and thin limbs but have a deep rounded thorax (bulging front and back in profile) over a pinched waist and narrow pelvis; L10/L12 have a wide waistless boxy trunk, short thick arms with oversized fists, short bowed bent-kneed legs and very large feet in a wide stance.
